title: Yangiliklar va podkastlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilidagi yangiliklar va podkastlarni eshita olasiz: yangiliklar lug‘atini (headline, breaking news, anchor), asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotni ajratishni, raqamlar va ismlarni eshitib tushunishni va eshitganingizni xulosalashni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Bugun: yangiliklar va podkastlarni eshitish
board: News and podcasts: follow what's happening
Vocabulary · Headlines · Main ideas · Numbers · Summary

examples.t: Did you catch the headlines this morning?

scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda tez nutqni tushunishni o‘rgangan edik. Bugun yangiliklar va podkastlarni eshitishni o‘rganamiz — har kuni uchraydigan, ayniqsa ish intervyulari va IELTS tinglashida kerak bo‘ladigan ko‘nikma. Dars oxirida bitta yangilikni besh jumlada xulosalay olasiz. Boshlaymiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today is about following the news and listening to podcasts — skills you use every single day, and especially in IELTS listening. By the end, you'll be able to summarise a news item in five sentences. Let's begin.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingiz bilan! Bugun yangiliklar va podkastlarni kuzatish haqida — buni har kuni, ayniqsa IELTS tinglashida ishlatasiz. Dars oxirida bitta yangilikni besh jumlada xulosalay olasiz. Boshlaymiz.

scenes.title: Yangiliklar lug‘ati

examples.t: The BBC News at Ten is a well-known bulletin.
examples.uz: BBC News at Ten mashhur qisqa yangiliklar dasturidir.

scenes.say_native: Yangiliklarda ko‘p ishlatiladigan so‘zlar: “headline” — sarlavha: gazetaning katta harflar bilan yozilgan asosiy gapi. “Breaking news” — shoshilinch yangilik — hozirgina yuz bergan voqea. “Bulletin” — qisqa yangiliklar — kuniga bir necha daqiqalik yangiliklar to‘plami. “Anchor” — yangiliklar boshlovchisi — studiya ichida o‘tib, yangiliklarni o‘qiydigan kishi — o‘zbek tilida “boshlovchi”. Endi shu so‘zlarni mashq qilamiz. O‘zbek tilida “bosh maqola” va “yangiliklar ko‘rsatuvi”. Diqqat: “headline” faqat sarlavha, “bulletin” — butun dastur. “News flash” — tezkor xabar.
scenes.say: Some news words you must know: a headline is the big title of a news story. Breaking news is something happening right now. A bulletin is a short news programme. An anchor is the person presenting the news from the studio.
scenes.say_uz: Biri yana: sarlavha — yangilikning katta sarlavhasi. Shoshilinch yangilik — hozirgina sodir bo‘lgan voqea. Qisqa yangiliklar — kuniga bir necha daqiqalik dastur. Boshlovchi — studiya ichida yangiliklarni o‘qiydigan kishi.

scenes.title: So‘zlarni moslashtiring
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta so‘zni o‘zbek tiliga tarjima qiling: headline, breaking news, bulletin, anchor. Baland ovozda ayting: sarlavha, shoshilinch yangilik, qisqa yangiliklar, boshlovchi. Har birini uch marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Match these four words to their meanings. Say the English word aloud, then repeat each one three times.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni moslashtiring: headline, breaking news, bulletin, anchor. O‘zbek tilida ayting: sarlavha, shoshilinch yangilik, qisqa yangiliklar, boshlovchi. Har birini uch marta takrorlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: headline — sarlavha, breaking news — shoshilinch yangilik, bulletin — qisqa yangiliklar, anchor — boshlovchi. Endi yana beshta yangilik so‘zini o‘rganamiz: correspondent — muxbir, broadcast — efirga uzatish, current affairs — dolzarb masalalar, coverage — yoritish, podcast — podkast, press release — matbuot bayonnomasi.
scenes.say: Answers: headline, breaking news, bulletin, anchor. Now five more words to learn: correspondent, broadcast, current affairs, coverage, podcast, press release.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: headline — sarlavha; breaking news — shoshilinch yangilik; bulletin — qisqa yangiliklar; anchor — boshlovchi. Endi yana beshta: correspondent, broadcast, current affairs, coverage, podcast, press release.

scenes.title: Yana yangilik so‘zlari: correspondent dan press release gacha

examples.t: Our correspondent in Kyiv reported live.

scenes.say_native: Yana so‘zlar: “correspondent” — muxbir — voqea joyida ishlaydigan, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri xabar beradigan jurnalist. “Broadcast” — efirga uzatish — radio yoki televizion efir. “Current affairs” — dolzarb masalalar — siyosat va jamiyat muammolari haqidagi dasturlar. “Coverage” — yoritish — masalan, “the election coverage was excellent”. “Press release” — matbuot bayonnomasi — tashkilotning rasmiy xabari. Endi shu so‘zlarni mashq qilamiz. O‘zbek tilida ham farq bor: “muxbir” voqea joyida, “sharhlovchi” studiya ichida. “Features” — hayotiy hikoyalar, “current affairs” — siyosiy dolzarb masalalar.
scenes.say: A correspondent reports from where the story is happening. A broadcast is a radio or TV transmission. Current affairs are programmes about politics and society. Coverage is how a story is reported. A press release is an official statement from an organisation.
scenes.say_uz: Correspondent — voqea joyidan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri xabar beradigan muxbir. Broadcast — radio yoki televizion efir. Current affairs — siyosat va jamiyat haqidagi dasturlar. Coverage — voqeaning yoritilishi. Press release — tashkilotning rasmiy xabari.

scenes.title: Yangi so‘zlarni tarjima qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta so‘zni tarjima qiling: correspondent — muxbir, broadcast — efirga uzatish, current affairs — dolzarb masalalar, coverage — yoritish. Baland ovozda ayting va har birini uch marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Translate these into Uzbek aloud, then repeat each one three times: correspondent, broadcast, current affairs, coverage.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni tarjima qiling: correspondent, broadcast, current affairs, coverage. Baland ovozda ayting: muxbir, efirga uzatish, dolzarb masalalar, yoritish. Har birini uch marta takrorlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: correspondent — muxbir, broadcast — efirga uzatish, current affairs — dolzarb masalalar, coverage — yoritish. Endi press release va podcast ni o‘rganamiz: press release — matbuot bayonnomasi, podcast — podkast — internetda eshitiladigan audio dastur.
scenes.say: Answers: correspondent, broadcast, current affairs, coverage. Now press release and podcast — an official statement, and an audio programme you listen to online.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: correspondent — muxbir; broadcast — efirga uzatish; current affairs — dolzarb masalalar; coverage — yoritish. Endi press release va podcast: matbuot bayonnomasi va internetda eshitiladigan audio dastur.

scenes.title: Headlines: telegraf uslubi
board: Fire hits city centre. (past) — present simple
Quake has struck coast. (recent) — present perfect

examples.t: Fire hits city centre after storm.
examples.uz: Bo‘rondan keyin shahar markaziga yong‘in tushdi.

scenes.say_native: Gazetalarning sarlavhalari odatdagidan farq qiladi: gaplar qisqa, yordamchi fe’lsiz, artiklsiz yoziladi. O‘tgan voqea hozirgi zamon bilan beriladi: “Fire hits city centre” — fe’l zamonida o‘tgan voqea. Yangi sodir bo‘lgan voqea present perfect bilan beriladi: “Quake has struck the coast.” Artikllar tashlanadi: “the” bo‘lmaydi. Endi shu qisqartirishlarni mashq qilamiz. Sarlavhada o‘tgan voqea hozirgi zamonda yoziladi: “hit” emas, “hits”. “The” har doim tushadi: “Quake has struck coast”.
scenes.say: Headlines are short and telegraphic. No articles, no auxiliary verbs. A past event uses the present simple: “Fire hits city centre.” A very recent event uses the present perfect: “Quake has struck the coast.”
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhalar qisqa va telegrafdek. Artikllar va yordamchi fe’llar yo‘q. O‘tgan voqea hozirgi zamon bilan: “Fire hits city centre.” Juda yaqinda sodir bo‘lgan voqea present perfect bilan: “Quake has struck the coast.”

scenes.title: Gaplarni sarlavhaga aylantiring
board: A fire hit the city centre last night. → ?
An earthquake has struck the coast. → ?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ikki gapni sarlavhaga aylantiring: “A fire hit the city centre last night.” — “Fire hits city centre.” “An earthquake has struck the coast.” — “Quake has struck coast.” Baland ovozda ayting va sarlavha qoidalari bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Turn these into headlines: “A fire hit the city centre last night” becomes “Fire hits city centre.” “An earthquake has struck the coast” becomes “Quake has struck coast.” Say them aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni sarlavhaga aylantiring: “A fire hit the city centre last night” → “Fire hits city centre.” “An earthquake has struck the coast” → “Quake has struck coast.” Baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Fire hits city centre.” “Quake has struck coast.” Qo‘shimcha qoida: passivning yordamchi fe’li ham tushib qoladi — “Three men arrested” — aslida “were” tushib qolgan. Endi yangiliklar eshitishga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Answers: “Fire hits city centre.” “Quake has struck coast.” One more rule: the passive auxiliary is often dropped too — “Three men arrested” really means “were arrested.”
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: “Fire hits city centre.” “Quake has struck coast.” Yana bir qoida: passivning yordamchi fe’li ham ko‘pincha tushib qoladi — “Three men arrested” aslida “were arrested”.

scenes.title: Tinglash: radio yangiliklari
scenes.say_native: Endi voqeani tinglang — oltidan yangiliklar. Birdaniga anglash qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin asosiy ma’lumotlarni ushlashga harakat qiling. Savollar tayyor bo‘lgandan keyin javoblarni tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Now listen to the six o‘clock bulletin. It may be fast, but try to catch the main points. You'll answer four questions afterwards.
scenes.say_uz: Endi oltidan yangiliklar eshitting. Tez bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin asosiy ma’lumotlarni topishga harakat qiling. Keyin to‘rtta savolga javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash matni: oltidan yangiliklar
board: Good evening. Here is the news at six.
A hospital in Leeds has closed its A&E.
In Rome, a new metro line opened today.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. Yangiliklarda har doim uch xil ma’lumot bor: asosiy voqea, kim bilan bog‘liq, va nega muhim. Bu nuqtalarni eslab qoling, keyin savol beramiz.
scenes.say: Good evening. Here is the news at six. A hospital in Leeds has closed its A&E department because of staff shortages. In Rome, a new metro line opened this morning, carrying two hundred thousand passengers on its first day. And in the south, flood warnings remain in place after last night's storm. More on all of this after the weather.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech. Soat oltidagi yangiliklar. Lidsda bir shifoxona xodimlar yetishmasligi sababli tez yordam bo‘limini yopdi. Rimda bugun ertalab yangi metro liniyasi ochildi, birinchi kun ikki yuz ming yo‘lovchini tashidi. Janubda esa kechagi bo‘rondan keyin suv toshqini ogohlantirishlari amalda qolmoqda. Ob-havodan keyin batafsil.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 3. How many passengers used the new line?
4. Where are flood warnings still in place?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta savolga javob bering: qaysi shifoxona tez yordam bo‘limini yopdi? Nega? Yangi metro qancha yo‘lovchi tashidi? Qayerda suv toshqini ogohlantirishlari qolmoqda? Baland ovozda ingliz tilida javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer these aloud: Which hospital closed its A&E? Why? How many passengers used the new line? Where are flood warnings still in place?
scenes.say_uz: Bularga baland ovozda javob bering: qaysi shifoxona tez yordam bo‘limini yopdi? Nega? Yangi metro necha yo‘lovchi tashidi? Qayerda suv toshqini ogohlantirishlari qolmoqda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Lidsda bir shifoxona, xodimlar yetishmasligi sababli, birinchi kun ikki yuz ming yo‘lovchi, janubda ogohlantirishlar amalda. Ko‘rib turibsiz, javoblar matnda aniq berilgan. Yangiliklarni shu tartibda tinglang: asosiy voqea, sabab, raqam.
scenes.say: Answers: a hospital in Leeds; because of staff shortages; two hundred thousand; in the south. Notice the order: main event, reason, numbers.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: Lidsda bir shifoxona; xodimlar yetishmasligi sababli; ikki yuz ming; janubda. Tartibga e’tibor bering: asosiy voqea, sabab, raqamlar.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oya va tafsilot
board: Then: who, what, when, where, why

examples.t: First ask: what is this about?

scenes.say_native: Yangiliklar va podkastlarda avval asosiy g‘oya — bu nima haqida — keyin tafsilotlar: kim, nima, qachon, qayerda, nega. Asosiy g‘oyani topmasdan tafsilotni eslay olmaysiz. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday qilasiz: “Bu nima haqida?” deb boshlang, keyin “Kim? Nima? Qachon? Qayerda? Nega?” deb davom eting. Asosiy g‘oya qoidasi: avval “What is this about?” — bu nima haqida? — deb so‘rang. Keyin tafsilotlarni to‘plang. Ingliz tilida IELTS tinglashda aynan shu tartibda ishlaysiz: savolni oldindan o‘qib, javobni topib, keyin tekshiring. Yangiliklarda ham shunday — asosiy ma’lumotni ushlang, keyin raqamlar va ismlarga o‘ting.
scenes.say: First find the main idea — what is it about? Then pick out the details: who, what, when, where, why. You can't remember details without the main idea. In Uzbek you'd do the same: start with “Bu nima haqida?” then ask kim, nima, qachon, qayerda, nega.
scenes.say_uz: Avval asosiy g‘oyani toping — bu nima haqida? Keyin tafsilotlarni ajrating: kim, nima, qachon, qayerda, nega. Asosiy g‘oyasiz tafsilotni eslab qola olmaysiz. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: “Bu nima haqida?” deb boshlang, keyin kim, nima, qachon, qayerda, nega deb so‘rang.

scenes.title: Asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotni ajrating
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Azodiyalgan uchta savolni ovoz chiqarib ingliz tilida javob bering: asosiy voqea nima edi? Kimlar ishtirok etdi? Qachon va qayerda bo‘ldi? Nega bo‘ldi? Har bir javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer aloud: What was the main event in the bulletin? Who was involved? When and where did it happen? Why?
scenes.say_uz: Baland ovozda javob bering: yangiliklardagi asosiy voqea nima edi? Kimlar ishtirok etdi? Qachon va qayerda bo‘ldi? Nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Leeds hospital A&E closure; Rome metro; floods
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: asosiy voqealar — Lidsdagi shifoxona tez yordamini yopishi, Rim metrosi ochilishi, janubdagi suv toshqinlari. Kimlar: xodimlar, yo‘lovchilar, bo‘ron. Qayerda: Lids, Rim, janub. Nega: xodimlar yetishmasligi. Endi xatalarni ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Answers: the main events were the Leeds A&E closure, the new Rome metro line and the floods in the south. Who: staff and passengers. Where: Leeds, Rome, the south. Why: staff shortages.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: asosiy voqealar — Lidsdagi tez yordam yopilishi, Rimdagi yangi metro liniyasi va janubdagi suv toshqinlari. Kimlar: xodimlar va yo‘lovchilar. Qayerda: Lids, Rim, janub. Nega: xodimlar yetishmasligi.

scenes.title: Keng tarqalgan xato: The news are good

examples.t: The news is always singular in English.
examples.uz: Yangiliklar ingliz tilida har doim birlikdadir.

scenes.say_native: Keng tarqalgan xato: “The news are good.” O‘zbek tilida “yangiliklar” ko‘plikda tuyuladi, lekin ingliz tilida “news” birlik, shuning uchun “is good”. Yana “He is correspondent” demang — maqola kerak: “He's a correspondent.” Endi shu xatolarni to‘g‘rilang.
scenes.say: The news is always singular: “The news is good.” And use an article: “He's a correspondent.”
scenes.say_uz: Yangiliklar har doim birlikda: “The news is good.” Yana maqola ishlating: “He's a correspondent.”

scenes.title: Xatolarni to‘g‘rilang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ikki xatoni to‘g‘rilang: “The news are bad” — “The news is bad.” “She is correspondent” — “She's a correspondent.” Baland ovozda ayting va artikl qoidasini eslang.
scenes.say: Correct these: “The news are bad” becomes “The news is bad.” “She is correspondent” becomes “She's a correspondent.” Say them aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni to‘g‘rilang: “The news are bad” → “The news is bad.” “She is correspondent” → “She's a correspondent.” Baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “The news is bad.” “She's a correspondent.” Endi keyingi bo‘limga o‘tamiz: podkastlar. Podkast tinglash yangiliklardan osonroq, chunki suhbat tezligida. Ammo podkastlarda ham asosiy raqam va sababni ushlab qolish kerak. Podkastni kundalik odatga aylantiring: har kuni atigi o‘n daqiqa.
scenes.say: Answers: “The news is bad.” “She's a correspondent.” Now let's move on to podcasts.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: “The news is bad.” “She's a correspondent.” Endi podkastlarga o‘tamiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash: podkast — ish haqida
scenes.say_native: Endi podkastni tinglang — “The Working Life” — haftalik ish hayoti haqidagi podkast. Ikki savol tayyor bo‘lgandan keyin javoblarni tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Listen to The Working Life podcast — a weekly show about work. Two questions follow.
scenes.say_uz: The Working Life podkastini tinglang — ish hayoti haqidagi haftalik ko‘rsatuv. Keyin ikkita savol keladi.

scenes.title: Podkast matni
board: This week: a new report says 40 million people work from home.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. Podkastda suhbatdagi asosiy g‘oya va bitta raqamni ushlang.
scenes.say: This week on The Working Life: a new report says forty million people now work from home at least part of the week. Is the office dead? Not dead — different, says our guest, Anna Reyes, who studies workplaces. Companies are keeping offices for meetings, not for daily desks. The research also suggests people working from home report more focus but less sense of belonging.
scenes.say_uz: Bu haftada The Working Life da: yangi hisobotga ko‘ra endi qirq million kishi haftaning kamida bir qismida uydan ishlaydi. Ofis o‘ldimi? Yo‘q — o‘zgargan, deydi bizning mehmonimiz, Anna Reyyes, ish joylarini o‘rganuvchi. Kompaniyalar ofislarni uchrashuvlar uchun saqlab qolmoqda, kundalik stollar uchun emas. Tadqiqot yana shuni ko‘rsatadiki, uydan ishlaydigan odamlar ko‘proq diqqat, lekin kamroq jamoaga tegishlilik hissi his qiladi.

scenes.title: Podkast savollari
board: 1. How many people work from home?
2. What do companies keep offices for?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ikki savolga javob bering: nechta odam uydan ishlaydi? Kompaniyalar ofislarni nima uchun saqlab qolmoqda? Baland ovozda ingliz tilida javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer aloud: How many people work from home at least part of the week? What do companies keep offices for now?
scenes.say_uz: Baland ovozda javob bering: qirq million odam uydan ishlaydi. Kompaniyalar endi ofislarni nima uchun saqlab qolmoqda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: qirq million, uchrashuvlar uchun. Ko‘rib turibsiz, podkastda ham raqam va sabab bor — xuddi yangiliklardagi kabi.
scenes.say: Answers: forty million; for meetings, not daily desks. Notice — podcasts also carry numbers and reasons, just like the news.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: qirq million; uchrashuvlar uchun. E’tibor bering — podkastlarda ham raqamlar va sabablar bor, xuddi yangiliklardagi kabi.

scenes.title: Raqamlar va ismlar yangiliklarda

examples.t: At least two hundred people gathered.

scenes.say_native: Yangiliklarda raqamlar ko‘pincha noaniq bo‘ladi: “at least” — kamida, “reportedly” — xabar qilinishicha, “so-called” — deb atalmish, “hundreds” — yuzlab, “dozens” — o‘nlab, “tens of thousands” — o‘n minglab. Ismlar oldida unvon bo‘ladi: “Dr Reyes”, “the Prime Minister”. Shubhali manbalar “reportedly” bilan beriladi. Yangiliklarda raqamlar sizni aldash uchun xizmat qiladi: “at least” nadir boshidan ma’lum, “reportedly” tasdiqlanmagan. O‘zbek tilida ham “xabar qilinganiga ko‘ra” deyiladi — xuddi shu. Ismni eshitganda unvonini ham eshitish kerak: “Dr Reyes said” — “Doctor Reyes aytdi”. Unvonni unutsangiz, kim nima aytganini adashtirib qo‘yasiz.
scenes.say: News numbers are often vague: “at least”, “reportedly”, “so-called”, “hundreds”, “dozens”, “tens of thousands.” Titles come before names: “Dr Reyes”, “the Prime Minister.” Uncertain sources use “reportedly.”
scenes.say_uz: Yangiliklardagi raqamlar ko‘pincha noaniq: “at least” — kamida, “reportedly” — xabar qilinishicha, “so-called” — deb atalmish, “hundreds” — yuzlab, “dozens” — o‘nlab, “tens of thousands” — o‘n minglab. Unvon ismdan oldin: “Dr Reyes”, “Bosh vazir”. Shubhali manbalar “reportedly” bilan beriladi.

scenes.title: Raqamlar va unvonlarni eshiting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ikki qisqa hisobotni tinglang va qanday raqamlarni eshitganingizni ayting. Raqamlarni ingliz tilida qayta ayting.
scenes.say: Listen to two short reports. Which numbers did you hear? Say them back in English.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki qisqa hisobotni tinglang. Qaysi raqamlarni eshitdingiz? Ularni ingliz tilida takrorlang.

scenes.title: Aniq raqamlar matni
board: Police say at least two hundred people attended.
Reportedly, dozens of homes were damaged.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. Qisqa hisobotdagi raqamlarga quloq soling.
scenes.say: Police say at least two hundred people attended the rally last night. Reportedly, dozens of homes were damaged in the storm, and tens of thousands of customers are without power. Dr Anna Reyes, who leads the workplace research team, described the findings as significant.
scenes.say_uz: Politsiya xabar berishicha, kecha mitingda kamida ikki yuz kishi ishtirok etgan. Xabar qilinishicha, bo‘ron paytida o‘nlab uylar shikastlangan va o‘n minglab iste’molchilar elektrsiz qolgan. Ish joyi tadqiqot guruhining rahbari Doktor Anna Reyes natijalarni muhim deb ta’rifladi.

scenes.title: Qaysi raqamlarni eshitdingiz?
board: 1. At least how many people attended?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta savolga javob bering: kamida nechta odam ishtirok etdi? Nechta uy shikastlandi? Nechta iste’molchi elektrsiz qoldi? Baland ovozda ingliz tilida javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer aloud: At least how many people attended the rally? How many homes were damaged? How many customers are without power?
scenes.say_uz: Baland ovozda javob bering: mitingda kamida necha kishi qatnashdi? Nechta uy shikastlandi? Necha iste’molchi elektrsiz qoldi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: kamida ikki yuz, o‘nlab uylar, o‘n minglab iste’molchilar. Yangiliklarda “at least” va “reportedly” kabi so‘zlar har doim noaniqlikni bildiradi — hech qachon aniq raqam deb o‘ylamang. Endi Xulosalashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Answers: at least two hundred; dozens of homes; tens of thousands of customers. “At least” and “reportedly” signal uncertainty — never treat them as exact figures. Now the summary skill.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: kamida ikki yuz; o‘nlab uylar; o‘n minglab iste’molchilar. “At least” va “reportedly” noaniqlikni bildiradi — ularni aniq raqam deb o‘ylamang. Endi Xulosalash ko‘nikmasi.

scenes.title: Xulosalash: eshitganingizni 1 jumlada
board: Your own words, not the original wording

examples.t: In short, the hospital closed because of staff shortages.
examples.uz: Qisqasi, shifoxona xodimlar yetishmasligi sababli yopildi.

scenes.say_native: Xulosalashning oddiy usuli: birinchi — asosiy g‘oyani bitta jumlada ayting: “In short, the hospital closed because of staff shortages.” Ikkinchi — ikki-uchta tafsilot qo‘shing. Uchinchi — o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting, eshitgan gaplaringizni ko‘chirmang. Ingliz tilida “In short”, “The main point is”, “Basically” bilan boshlang. Xulosalashda e’tiborli joy: “In short” bilan boshlang — bu tinglovchiga tugashga yaqin ekaningizni bildiradi. Keyin asosiy g‘oya va ikki tafsilot. Ingliz tilida “In conclusion” esa rasmiy yozma xulosa uchun, og‘zakida esa “In short” yoki “The main point is” yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: Summarise in three steps: first, the main point in one sentence — “In short, the hospital closed because of staff shortages.” Second, two or three details. Third, use your own words, not the original. Start with “In short,” “The main point is,” or “Basically.”
scenes.say_uz: Xulosalash uch qadam: birinchidan, asosiy g‘oyani bitta jumlada — “In short, the hospital closed because of staff shortages.” Ikkinchidan, ikki-uchta tafsilot. Uchinchidan, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting, asl gapni ko‘chirmang. “In short,” “The main point is,” yoki “Basically” bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Yangilikni xulosalang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ovoz chiqarib uni xulosalang: “In short, the hospital closed because of staff shortages. The new Rome metro opened and carried two hundred thousand passengers. Flood warnings remain in the south.” Baland ovozda ayting va ichki jumla bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Summarise the bulletin aloud in three sentences, starting with “In short.”
scenes.say_uz: Yangiliklarni baland ovozda uch jumlada xulosalang, “In short” bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: In short, the hospital closed due to staff shortages.
Flood warnings remain in the south.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “In short, the hospital closed due to staff shortages. The new Rome metro opened, carrying two hundred thousand passengers. Flood warnings remain in the south.” Bu endi yaxshi xulosa. Endi yakuniy vazifa.
scenes.say: Answers: “In short, the hospital closed due to staff shortages. The new Rome metro opened, carrying two hundred thousand passengers. Flood warnings remain in the south.” That's a good summary. Now the final task.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: “In short, the hospital closed due to staff shortages. The new Rome metro opened, carrying two hundred thousand passengers. Flood warnings remain in the south.” Bu yaxshi xulosa. Endi yakuniy vazifa.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: bitta yangilikni besh jumlada xulosalang
board: Choose one news item you've heard today.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa: bugun eshitgan bitta yangilikni besh jumlada xulosalang. “In short, …” bilan boshlang, asosiy voqeani, ikki tafsilotni va nima uchun muhimligini ayting. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose one news item from today. Summarise it in five sentences, starting with “In short.” Include the main event, two details and why it matters. Say it aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Bugungi bitta yangilikni tanlang. Uni besh jumlada xulosalang, “In short” bilan boshlang. Asosiy voqeani, ikki tafsilotni va nega muhimligini ayting. Baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: at least · reportedly · tens of thousands
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Yangiliklar lug‘atini (headline, breaking news, bulletin, anchor, correspondent), sarlavhalarning telegraf uslubini, asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotni ajratishni, raqamlar va noaniqlik so‘zlarini (at least, reportedly, tens of thousands) va eshitganingizni xulosalashni o‘rgandik. Endi keyingi darsda onlayn muloqot va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni o‘rganamiz. Uy vazifasi majburiy: bitta yangilikni besh jumlada xulosalab, yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Today we covered news vocabulary, headline style, main idea and details, vague numbers like “at least” and “tens of thousands,” and summarising. Next time: online communication and social media.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun yangiliklar lug‘atini, sarlavha uslubini, asosiy g‘oya va tafsilotni, “at least” va “tens of thousands” kabi noaniq raqamlarni hamda xulosalashni o‘rgandik. Keyingi darsda onlayn muloqot va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni o‘rganamiz.
